beats.summary: Michael mistakenly calls a Wendy's restaurant thinking it is a person named Wendy.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hello Wendy, this is Kevin's friend, Michael.
Wendy’s phone operator: Dude, this is a Wendy's restaurant.

beats.summary: Dwight discovers that the chair model Michael was interested in, Deborah Shoshlefski, is dead from a car accident.

evidence.snippet: Michael: She's dead? She's so young.

beats.summary: Pam offers to set Michael up with her landlady to help him move on from his loss.

evidence.snippet: Pam: OK Michael, you know what? I might have someone for you.
Pam: I'm setting Michael up with my land lady. She's really sweet and… whatever, I just can't take Michael like this.

beats.summary: Kevin calls a meeting of the five business park bosses to address parking space issues.

evidence.snippet: Kevin: We need to assemble the five families.
Kevin: We want our parking spaces back!

beats.summary: Michael meets Margaret, the landlady, but the meeting ends awkwardly.

notable_quotes.quote: I will find her and I will bring her to you and as God as my witness, she shall bear your fruit.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I wrote that. Michael, you shouldn't have to settle. This is my pledge to you. I will find her and I will bring her to you and as God as my witness, she shall bear your fruit.

notable_quotes.quote: Why is it so hard to meet people? I… you know… it's uh… All I want is somebody nice and sweet and someone I can talk to and share an experience with, you know?
